description: A React functional component named 'Title' that renders a stylized, animated heading using Remotion library hooks for video rendering. The component splits input text into words and applies spring-based scaling animations to each word based on the current video frame.

methods.name: Title
methods.description: React functional component that displays an animated title text, splitting text into words and applying scale animations based on video frame using hooks from Remotion.

calls: spring({ fps: videoConfig.fps, frame: frame - delay, config: { damping: 200 } })
